organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Wholesale-style operation moving fruit and vegetables to 13 partners. Walk-in cold rooms sized for crates and pallets of fresh product. Reefer available daily. We can be there within a couple of hours.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 6% of residents below the poverty line, 7% of households without a vehicle, 6% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Anso Child Development team,

A farm south of Chicago has 5 tons of potatoes. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 72 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 53 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
